clips.title: The story
paras: At Razor Hill, Furl Scornbrow gathers Canvas Scraps to make travel sacks for new Horde recruits. The cloth comes from human invaders and centaur tribes in Durotar.

Kul Tiras marines and sailors carry canvas along Durotar’s eastern shore. Their gear and sails leave scraps behind. Inland, Kolkar centaur reuse coarse cloth taken from supply caravans and past conflicts. Their camps and gear hold scraps that can be salvaged.

Furl Scornbrow watches for invaders from the Razor Hill watchtower. The aging veteran has left his fighting days behind, but puts salvaged enemy cloth to use. He stitches it into sturdy carrying bags for younger soldiers, helping the new generation defend the Horde’s borders.
